source.version_difference: CN and EN align structurally on 212 text positions (210 named, 2 unnamed) and 133 command positions. Source line numbers match; EN has one terminal newline absent in CN. Six semantic/lexical differences are documented in the translated prefix; Russian follows CN.

version_differences.cn_meaning: CN explicitly says a controlling spell drives the bodies of already-dead Infected.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN generalizes this as bodies being propped up by Arts.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian follows the more specific CN meaning: a spell of control/subjugation.

version_differences.cn_meaning: Hoshiguma has seen the terminal advertisement so often that she accidentally memorized its slogan; no explicit million-times hyperbole.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian follows CN without adding numerical exaggeration.

version_differences.cn_meaning: 你不会信的 — 'You wouldn't believe it'.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN: 'But that's not what you're here for'.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian follows CN: 'Ты ведь не поверишь'.

version_differences.en_meaning: EN: knew me half as well as you do.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian follows CN: 'такими же разумными, как ты'.

version_differences.cn_meaning: 鬼姐 — affectionate 'Oni sister/older sister Oni'.
version_differences.ru_decision: Working CN-primary form: 'сестрица Они'; requires later terminology review.

version_differences.cn_meaning: 电单车 specifies an electric motorcycle/bike.
CN lists a scratch, a folded corner and a yellow stain.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN substitutes a tear and a dog-eared page for two of the listed details.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian follows CN: царапина, загнутый уголок, жёлтое пятно.

version_differences.cn_meaning: CN says they were beaten into dust and explicitly adds that Hoshiguma herself had a hand in the violence.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN compresses the disappearance into dust and foregrounds the dreams she smashed.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian retains both the destruction of the people and Hoshiguma's own participation.

version_differences.cn_meaning: CN explicitly says Hoshiguma herself left them with nowhere to live.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN softens this to 'that was my fault'.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian preserves the explicit agency: именно она лишила их последнего пристанища.

version_differences.cn_meaning: CN says Ch'en is of the Ch'en family bloodline and will not be implicated after this.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN paraphrases the consequence as nobody coming after her.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian follows CN: после этого Чэнь не втянут в это дело.

version_differences.cn_meaning: CN uses the images of untangling problems and clearing lingering poison left at every level.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN reduces the image to cleaning out rot left behind.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian keeps the CN images of untangling problems and removing lingering poison.

version_differences.cn_meaning: CN says Wei has been waiting for a particular moment and that his gaze and methods have not changed.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN says he has waited a long time and changes 'gaze' to 'beliefs'.
version_differences.ru_decision: Russian follows CN: он ждал подходящего момента; его взгляд и методы не изменились.

version_differences.cn_meaning: 别骗我 means 'Don't lie to me'.
version_differences.en_meaning: EN renders it as 'Don't mess with me'.

notes: Source hashes were rechecked earlier in this run and match the pinned community mirror revisions.
Command positions are recorded as metadata only; full source command text is not copied into the translation JSON.
Six CN/EN semantic or lexical differences in the translated prefix are documented; CN is primary.
No full CN/EN scripts or game assets are committed.
v2.11 adds positions 81–120; source command positions 199–203 are retained.
